releases.name: v1.5.1
releases.descriptionHTML:
• 支持 riscv64 架构
  • 增加 zygote-blacklist ，允许停止注入某些 zygote （通过 WebUI 开关或 znctl zygote-blacklist 命令设置）
  • 修复 Android 17 QPR2 支持
  • 适配开启 CONFIG_PROC_MEM_FORCE_PTRACE 的内核
  • 修复一些其他问题
  • Added support for the riscv64 architecture
  • Added a zygote blacklist to allow disabling injection into specific zygotes (configurable via the WebUI toggle or the znctl zygote-blacklist command)
  • Fixed support for Android 17 QPR2
  • Added compatibility for kernels with CONFIG_PROC_MEM_FORCE_PTRACE enabled
  • Fixed various other issues
